Made to order, not in stock

These pieces are ordered from the supplier: allow 2 to 3 weeks before delivery. We call you to book the day as soon as you order, and we carry it up your stairs.

The price shown is the price paid

GST and QST are already in both prices: the promotion price and the struck-through regular price beside it. Your cart total is exactly what is charged to your card.

After December 12

Prices return to regular by themselves, with nothing to switch off. An order placed during the promotion keeps its price: what counts is the price paid at checkout.
